## What it is

Boîtier de dérivation coffeeflow : trois Wago 221-423 sur le châssis d'une Profitec Go. Deux aimants 8×3 mm, pas de perçage. Couvercle visé en M3.

## Contexte projet

coffeeflow = électronique sur machine espresso (ESP32-S3 / M5Stack Atom S3 Voice) : firmware à la racine du dépôt, impressions dans `print/`. Pièces prévues : ce boîtier de dérivation, plus tard un boîtier capteurs et un boîtier écran.

- Imprimante : Bambu Lab A1 Mini, buse 0,4 mm.
- Filament : Bambu Lab PETG HF Black, SKU 33102.
- Vis : **M3 uniquement**. Trou imprimé 2,5 mm, vis autoforeuse, déjà validé sur cette machine.
- Fils : Helukabel Helutherm 145, 0,75 mm², Ø ext. 2,2 mm. Encoches 2,5 mm.
- Câblage : 6 entrées sur la grande face opposée aux Wago (2 par connecteur), 3 sorties sur la petite face x = 0.
- Châssis ~40–50 °C : les Wago reposent sur 4 picots de 3 mm, sans toucher le fond ni les parois (`jeu_wago` 0,3 mm).
- Fixation machine : friction des aimants, fond local 0,6 mm.

Cette version (premier essai imprimé) pose **trois** Wago **à plat**. Elle est à remplacer : le boîtier 230 V cible a **quatre** Wago 221-423 **verticaux** (phase machine, neutre, phase brew, phase pompe — détail dans `../../README.md`). Ne pas éditer cette pièce en layout vertical : nouvelle pièce.

## Design notes

Inner cavity is 62 x 30 mm, walls 1.6 mm, so the outer envelope is 65.2 x 33.2 x 20 mm. The 0.84 mm murets and rail are two 0.42 mm perimeters on the A1 Mini 0.4 mm nozzle. Magnet wells leave 0.6 mm of floor (three 0.2 mm layers) so the discs hold through the plastic.

The 2.5 mm holes in the cable-channel bosses are for M3 thread-forming screws. Confirmed on this printer in PETG HF 33102: the screw taps and holds. The hole starts at the inner floor and does not break through the bottom.

Six wire notches on the long wall opposite the Wagos (entries), three on the short wall at x = 0 (exits).

Bambu Studio warns on nurb 3MF (spec 1.41). Export STL from `print/build/`.

## Don't

- Do not run the M3 holes through the floor. A through-hole left a 0.2 mm cusp at the boss and opens the chassis face.
- Do not polish inner vertical edges. A 1 mm chamfer on 1.6 mm walls left 1.2 mm strips at concave junctions (`concave_cosmetic`). Only the four outer corners are polished.
- Do not enlarge the 2.5 mm M3 holes, and do not switch to M4: M3 already works on this A1 Mini with PETG HF.
- Do not thicken the 0.84 mm murets or the 0.6 mm magnet floor for the min_wall default. Those sizes are the fit.
- Do not let a Wago touch the floor or the walls. Picots and `jeu_wago` are the thermal/clearance rules.
- Do not put the three exit notches on the +X short face; they belong on x = 0.
- Do not edit this part into the four-Wago vertical layout. That is a new part. This file is the first three-Wago flat print.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 0.6
```

## Changelog

- Stopped M3 holes at the inner floor and fused the bosses into the long wall so they no longer leave a tangent cusp.
- Polish limited to the four outer corners.
- CAD tree moved to `print/` so coffeeflow root stays firmware.
